notes:
FortressTV 2.0.0-RC14:
- TV Series episode metadata enrichment: fetches per-episode overviews, episode titles, and high-resolution 16:9 stills from TMDB.
- Xtream season synopsis fallback: parses season-level overviews from get_series_info when provider episode info is empty.
- Next Up banner synopsis: shows episode description on the Next Up hero card in the series dialog.
- Auto (Match Profile) language: metadata and episode descriptions automatically follow the active household profile (pt-PT -> pt-BR -> en-US cascade for Portuguese profiles; English for English profiles).
